$M=-K\theta$
$M=J\alpha$
$\alpha=\frac{d^{2}\theta}{dt^{2}}=-\frac{K}{J}\theta$
$\omega^{2}=\frac{K}{J}$
$T=\frac{2\pi}{\omega}=2\pi\sqrt{\frac{J}{K}}$
$J=\frac{KT^{2}}{4\pi^{2}}$
$J_{1}=\frac{1}{8}mD^{2}$
$K=\frac{4\pi^{2}J_{1}}{T_{1}^{2}-T_{0}^{2}}$
$J_{0}=\frac{KT_{0}^{2}}{4\pi^{2}}$
$J=\frac{K(T^{2}-T_{0}^{2})}{4\pi^{2}}$
$J=\frac{KT^{2}}{4\pi^{2}}$
$J_{2}=\frac{1}{8}m(D_{1}^{2}+D_{2}^{2})$
$J_{3}=\frac{1}{10}mD^{2}$
$J=J_{0}+md^{2}$
$J_{1\mathrm{理}}=\frac{1}{8}mD^{2}=\frac{1}{8}\times 1.11612\times (0.10050)^{2}=1.4091\times 10^{-3}\,\mathrm{kg\cdot m^{2}}$
$J_{2\mathrm{理}}=\frac{1}{8}m(D_{1}^{2}+D_{2}^{2})=\frac{1}{8}\times 0.66890\times (0.09384^{2}+0.10000^{2})=1.572\times 10^{-3}\,\mathrm{kg\cdot m^{2}}$
$J_{3\mathrm{理}}=\frac{1}{10}mD^{2}=\frac{1}{10}\times 1.06137\times (0.11120)^{2}=1.312\times 10^{-3}\,\mathrm{kg\cdot m^{2}}$
$K=\frac{4\pi^{2}J_{1\mathrm{理}}}{T_{1}^{2}-T_{0}^{2}}=\frac{4\times 3.1416^{2}\times 1.4091\times 10^{-3}}{1.483^{2}-0.774^{2}}=0.0348\,\mathrm{N\cdot m/rad}$
$J_{0}=\frac{KT_{0}^{2}}{4\pi^{2}}=\frac{0.0348\times 0.774^{2}}{39.478}=5.28\times 10^{-4}\,\mathrm{kg\cdot m^{2}}$
$J_{1\mathrm{实}}=\frac{K(T_{1}^{2}-T_{0}^{2})}{4\pi^{2}}=1.4091\times 10^{-3}\,\mathrm{kg\cdot m^{2}}$
$J_{2\mathrm{实}}=\frac{K(T_{2}^{2}-T_{0}^{2})}{4\pi^{2}}=\frac{0.0348\times (1.556^{2}-0.774^{2})}{39.478}=1.604\times 10^{-3}\,\mathrm{kg\cdot m^{2}}$
$J_{3\mathrm{实}}=\frac{KT_{3}^{2}}{4\pi^{2}}=\frac{0.0348\times 1.172^{2}}{39.478}=1.206\times 10^{-3}\,\mathrm{kg\cdot m^{2}}$
$E_{2}=\frac{\left|J_{2\mathrm{实}}-J_{2\mathrm{理}}\right|}{J_{2\mathrm{理}}}\times 100\%=2.04\%$
$E_{3}=\frac{\left|J_{3\mathrm{实}}-J_{3\mathrm{理}}\right|}{J_{3\mathrm{理}}}\times 100\%=8.08\%$
$md^{2}=0.68543\times 0.05^{2}=1.71\times 10^{-3}\,\mathrm{kg\cdot m^{2}}$
